summary: Repaired /srv/inventory on node1. Existing contents were preserved, permissions survived reboot, and access checks passed.
actions_performed: Created system account inventorysvc and system group inventory-readers.
Set directories to 0750 and files to 0640.
Verified owner and group read access, group write denial, and complete denial for other users.
Restarted node1 and verified persistence and recovery.

evidence.summary: Both files retained identical SHA-256 hashes before repair, after repair, and after reboot.
All objects are inventorysvc:inventory-readers; directories are 0750 and files are 0640. Direct tests confirmed reader access, denied reader writes, and denied other-user access.

Healthy baseline captured, reboot acknowledged, boot ID changed from 54bd1c3e-3a1b-4913-841b-88512119e096 to a01a759c-40ef-4c01-967b-58b576199dd0, and the system, data, ownership, ACLs, and access behavior recovered correctly.
